name: OpenConditions Contributions API
description: Crowd-report intake and evidence lifecycle for road conditions: verifies signed device reports, deduplicates and corroborates co-located phenomena, cross-validates against official feeds, and serves the operator reviewer surface — all over the shared PostGIS `conditions` schema. Peer confirmation never routes or trains reputation on its own; only official-feed cross-validation (and operator resolution) does.
author: OpenConditions

DATABASE_URL.title: Database URL
DATABASE_URL.description: Required. PostgreSQL/PostGIS connection URL of the shared OpenMapX database, e.g. postgresql://postgres:<POSTGRES_PASSWORD>@postgis:5432/openmapx. The service refuses to start without it.

OPENCONDITIONS_GRANT_SECRET.title: Reporting grant secret
OPENCONDITIONS_GRANT_SECRET.description: Required. HMAC secret that signs reporting grants; generate with openssl rand -hex 32. The service refuses to start without it.

OPENCONDITIONS_REVIEWER_TOKEN.title: Reviewer token
OPENCONDITIONS_REVIEWER_TOKEN.description: Required. Bearer token of the operator reviewer surface; generate with openssl rand -hex 32. The service refuses to start without it.

OPENCONDITIONS_INSTANCE_ID.title: Instance id
OPENCONDITIONS_INSTANCE_ID.description: This instance's stable id, the namespace of the crowd records it lands and its crowd's credit: lower-case letters, digits, dots and dashes, e.g. maps.example.org. Set it to the same value as the ingest service's. Empty: local.

OPENCONDITIONS_CROSS_VALIDATE_SWEEP.title: Cross-validate sweep
OPENCONDITIONS_CROSS_VALIDATE_SWEEP.description: "off" stops the sweep that re-runs cross-validation over unresolved crowd reports when an official feed lands later. Empty: on.

OPENCONDITIONS_CROWD_LICENSE.title: Crowd licence
OPENCONDITIONS_CROWD_LICENSE.description: The licence this instance's crowd reports are published under: an SPDX id or LicenseRef-<name> of the licence registry, case exact. An unknown id fails boot. Empty: ODbL-1.0.

OPENCONDITIONS_CROWD_SOURCE_URI.title: Crowd credit URL
OPENCONDITIONS_CROWD_SOURCE_URI.description: The link the crowd's credit carries on every report this instance lands. Empty: none.

OPENCONDITIONS_ALLOW_POLICE_CATEGORY.title: Allow police-presence reports
OPENCONDITIONS_ALLOW_POLICE_CATEGORY.description: "true" lets crowd reports of police presence land. Empty: refused.
